original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥孙州APC取消平行竞选委员会
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥孙州全体进步大会党（APC）取消了其平行的总统竞选架构，并将竞选委员会更名为奥孙州全体进步大会党议会竞选委员会。在竞选团队初始构成引发抗议后，该党将立法竞选委员会成员扩大至183人，纳入所有州执行委员会成员。此前该党曾公布一个168人的平行总统/议会竞选委员会，为总统蒂努布的连任及其他候选人拉票。

key_facts.fact: 奥孙州APC取消平行总统竞选架构并更名竞选委员会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Osun State chapter of the All Progressives Congress has discontinued its parallel presidential campaign structure and renamed its campaign council the Osun State All Progressives Congress Parliamentary Campaign Council.

key_facts.fact: 竞选团队初始构成引发抗议后，该党扩大委员会成员至183人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The party also expanded the legislative campaign council’s membership to accommodate all members of the state executive committee following protests over the initial composition of the campaign team.

key_facts.fact: 新委员会在奥索博公布，纳入所有州执行委员会成员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The new 183-man council unveiled in Osogbo on Tuesday accommodated all state executives.

key_facts.fact: 此前该党曾公布168人平行竞选委员会为蒂努布连任拉票
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Osun APC unveiled a 168-man parallel presidential/parliamentary campaign council that will work for the re-election of President Tinubu and canvass votes for other candidates contesting on the platform of the party in the 2027 general elections.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未说明抗议的具体规模与组织方
